text: dsh-gemini-tool-schema 是面向 DSH 的 TypeScript 插件，在 system-prompt/assemble 阶段处理即将交给模型的工具参数 Schema。它按 provider/model 路由选择是否生效，并将 JSON Schema 转为 Gemini 函数声明可接受的子集。插件可规范化可空联合、数组缺失的 items、枚举空值和引用定义，也能裁剪不支持的关键字。使用者可以设置匹配模式、数组元素默认类型、dry run、日志和离线结构转储，适合需要让 Gemini 路由兼容 DSH 内置、MCP 及其他插件工具的场景；源码没有要求额外 API key。

dsh-gemini-tool-schema normalizes DSH tool schemas during assembly for Gemini routes. It filters by provider/model and fixes nullable unions, arrays without items, empty enum entries, and references. It covers built-in, MCP, and plugin tools, with optional logs and schema dumps.
让 DSH 发给 Gemini 的工具参数符合它接受的 Schema 格式
Gemini 函数调用因为工具参数定义不兼容而报错，怎么统一修正？
希望在模型请求前自动规范化所有插件和 MCP 工具的参数结构
给不同 provider/model 路由设置哪些工具 Schema 需要转换
Make DSH tool parameter schemas compatible with Gemini function declarations.
Normalize schemas from built-in tools, MCP servers, and other DSH plugins before requests.
dsh-gemini-tool-schema 的功能「路由筛选」：在组装阶段按 provider/model 与 all、list、off 模式选择是否规范化工具参数，并可指定未知路由的处理方式。
dsh-gemini-tool-schema 的功能「Schema cleanup」：插件递归规范化工具参数 Schema：补齐类型与数组 items，合并空值联合和引用定义，清理空枚举项及不支持的关键字，并提供 lint 结果。
dsh-gemini-tool-schema 的功能「Diagnostics and inspection」：使用者可启用 dry run、逐次组装日志及 dumpDir 转储，记录处理数量和发现项，便于检查模型实际收到的工具定义。

dsh-gemini-tool-schema README · The problem：Strict providers accept only a *subset* of JSON Schema. Google Gemini's `functionDeclarations[].parameters` rejects the **whole request** (HTTP 400) when:

dsh-gemini-tool-schema README · The problem：| Real error | Offending schema | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema didn't specify the schema type field` | `{ anyOf: [{type:'string',…}, {type:'null'}] }` — no `type` | Playwright MCP `browser_emulate_media.colorScheme` (`z.string().nullable()`) |
| `properties[v_types].items: missing field` | `{ type: 'array' }` — no `items` | Lingshu MCP `lingshu_cg` / `lingshu_stg` (19 params) |
| `properties[permission].enum[3]: cannot be empty` | `enum: [..., '']` | DSH built-in `task_board_update.permission` |
dsh-gemini-tool-schema README · The problem：All three are legal elsewhere, which is why the failure only shows up on a Gemini-flavoured route.

dsh-gemini-tool-schema README · Why a Harness hook：An MCP proxy only reaches the servers it wraps. Built-in tools and tools registered by other plugins never cross an MCP transport, so normalizing at Harness assembly time is the only fix that covers **every** tool at once.

dsh-gemini-tool-schema README · Install：```sh
git clone https://github.com/ChenXu233/dsh-gemini-tool-schema.git
cd dsh-gemini-tool-schema && npm install && npm run build
```

Append to `<DSH home>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: gemini-tool-schema
      name: '/absolute/path/to/dsh-gemini-tool-schema/dist/index.js'
      config:

Or `npm install dsh-gemini-tool-schema` and mount it by package name.

dsh-gemini-tool-schema README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `list` | `all` every request · `list` matching APIs only · `off` disabled |
| `apis` | `['gemini','google','vertex']` | API patterns, **compiled as regular expressions** |
| `unknownApi` | `apply` | When the route cannot be read: `apply` or `skip` |
| `itemsFallback` | `{type:'string'}` | Element schema for arrays that omit `items` |
| `nullable` | `true` | Emit `nullable: true` for null unions |
| `dryRun` | `false` | Report and lint, but send the original schemas |
| `logFile` / `logLevel` | none / `info` | One diagnostic line per assembly |
| `dumpDir` / `dumpSchemas` | none / `true` | Dump the model-facing tool set for offline auditing |

dsh-gemini-tool-schema README · Configuration：Patterns match against `provider/model` (e.g. `gemini-lumiya/gemini-4-argon`) and accept substring, regex, and `/pattern/flags` forms; an entry that does not compile degrades to a case-insensitive substring match. `'*'` matches everything, or set `mode: all`.

dsh-gemini-tool-schema README · Rules：Every node gets a `type`; every array gets `items`; `enum` entries are never empty (and `const` cannot reintroduce one); `$ref`/`$defs` are inlined cycle-safely; unsupported keywords are stripped and the remaining scalars pass an allow-list; `required` is narrowed to real properties.

dsh-gemini-tool-schema README · Development：```sh
npm test        # Node ≥22.6 runs the TS tests directly — 36 tests
npm run build   # tsc → dist/
```
